purpose: Track the dated field, dynamic, foreign-visitor and commercial-release checks required before a city roadbook can be called human-checked.

release_policy.digital_roadbook: May be offered only as a research draft with human review; no third-party inventory is included.
release_policy.experience_product: May not be quoted, booked or paid until the relevant launch checks and supplier/resource gates pass.
release_policy.dynamic_information: Opening, weather, transport, programmes, access, prices and road conditions must be rechecked for the traveller date.
release_policy.evidence: A web source or supplier self-description is a lead, not field verification. Each pass needs dated evidence and a named reviewer.
